fundamental.summary: VTRS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 87 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (12/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (one small sale 120 days ago, one large purchase 358 days ago) and absent recent news sentiment provide insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (415.5), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and recent CPI miss create severely unfavourable macro conditions despite distant earnings event.
